findings.comment: Multiple departmental reviews have pending unresolved items: Drainage Engineering (9 pending items including easement documentation, basin setback, maintenance ramp waivers, channel profiles and cross-sections); Fire Department (2 pending items for standard notes and SER documentation); Water Quality (6 pending items for water quality design, impervious cover treatment, landscape plans, and basin ratios); Austin Water (2 pending items including required Service Extension Request); Transportation (1 pending item); and PARD (1 pending item). Approval stamps on cover sheet remain blank with no departmental signatures obtained. Site plan has not been released for general compliance and remains in comment response phase.

Parks and Recreation Department review (item PR1) status is listed as PENDING in the Master Comment Report. While the reviewer notes the comment will be cleared prior to site plan approval, the formal clearance has not yet been obtained. The parkland dedication fee amount ($177,244.24) has been calculated for 39 units but must be verified and fee payment processed prior to certificate of occupancy, not site plan approval; however, the departmental review sign-off is required before site plan approval.

documentReferences.label: Master Comment Report - Fire For Site Plan Review

findings.comment: Fire Department approval has not been obtained and documented. Comment F1 (status: PENDING) requires standard Fire Department notes on the general notes sheet. Comment F4 (status: PENDING) requires documentation of Service Extension Request (SER) approval for fire hydrant flow test, as the measured available fire flow of 1,471 GPM at 20 psi is insufficient to support the reduced fire flow demand of 1,500 GPM shown on the cover sheet. AFD approval has not been signed off.

findings.comment: Whether Public Works Department (Office of the City Engineer) review and approval is required for this site plan cannot be verified from the available documents. Land Development Engineering review is documented with pending items (License Agreement needed), but explicit OCE approval status and requirement cannot be confirmed.

Land Development Engineering comments exist but do not constitute formal design review authority approval memo.

findings.comment: Pipeline Engineering review and approval has not been completed. The Pipeline Engineering section shows a 2nd review on 9/29/25 with redline comments (accessible via external link), indicating unresolved issues remain. Related Austin Water comment AW2 confirms review comments will not be satisfied until Pipeline Engineering has approved the water and wastewater utility plan. Approval has not been documented.
Maintenance and Operations (M&O) review and approval status cannot be verified from the submitted documents. No M&O reviewer comments or sign-off appear in the Master Comment Report.

applicableAreas: Watershed Protection Department impervious cover allocation
findings.comment: Watershed Protection Department impervious cover allocation approval documentation cannot be located in the submitted documents. While the Consolidated Site Plan Application shows proposed impervious cover of 59.5% (within the 65% cap for this urban watershed), formal WPD allocation approval documentation and submission cannot be verified as completed and approved before site plan approval.

findings.comment: Whether Austin Water AMOC (Alternate Means of Compliance) approval is required and whether documentation has been obtained cannot be verified from the submitted documents. No explicit AMOC approval or denial is documented in the Master Comment Report sections reviewed.

Owner's Letter of Recognition (documenting that no CO, TCO, or water meters will be released until all required infrastructure is installed, tested, and accepted) cannot be verified as obtained from the submitted documents. The requirement and documentation status are not addressed in the Master Comment Report.
